headline: US Dollar Index Hits 22-Month High as Nigerian Naira Faces Pressure
summary: The Nigerian Naira faced ongoing foreign exchange pressure amid a surging U.S. Dollar Index reaching a 22-month high and high domestic FX demand ahead of holidays.
why: A strong US Dollar Index increases import costs and exerts depreciation pressure on emerging market currencies.

impacts.name: US Dollar Index
impacts.why: The US Dollar Index reached a 22-month high.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strong macroeconomic demand for US dollars and holiday liquidity needs drove the currency index higher.
